spd_f.desc: clip((f_A - f_B) / s_f, -4, 4): posterior fast first-serve-speed state (audit C3), men; women 0; never NaN

spd_raw.desc: clip(x_raw / 5.998, -4, 4): the registered 14-day minus 364-day statistic on the new panel, men with both sides timed in 14 days; NaN otherwise

spd_f_all.desc: spd_f with women's Slam values from the women's constants and the men's s_f; never NaN
